config.relativity.title: Relativity
config.relativity.option.instant_world_e: Return to the menu instantly when leaving a world; it keeps saving in the background.
config.relativity.option.item_frame_cach: Item frames that don't change cost almost nothing to draw.
config.relativity.option.item_frame_extr: Item frames that don't change skip most of their per-frame preparation.
config.relativity.restart_required: Restart the game to apply the changes.
config.relativity.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.relativity.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.relativity.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
